title: Hand-rolled HTTP/1.1 parser instead of a framework
evidence: books.erl:46-71 reads headers/body over gen_tcp; no cowboy/inets. Works and is dependency-free, but handles only Content-Length bodies (no chunked encoding).
suggestion: Acceptable for the task; note chunked request bodies are unsupported.

title: PUT uses full-replace semantics
evidence: books.erl:92 item PUT calls with_book then books_store:update with a fresh #{title,author,year,isbn}; README documents 'PUT replaces the book's fields and requires title and author'.
suggestion: Matches the spec ('Update a book'); partial-update (PATCH-like) is not required.

title: reason/1 lacks a catch-all clause
evidence: books.erl:119 reason/1 enumerates 200/201/400/404/405/500; an unlisted status would crash serve/1. All codes actually produced are covered, so unreachable in practice.
suggestion: Add a default clause (e.g. reason(_) -> "") for defensiveness.
